title: Bontrager AW3 Hard-Case Lite Road Tire
notes: Official Trek US page read 2026-11-01 (titled 'All-New AW3 Road Tires'): 'A performance road tire with best-in-class defense against flats and a long-lasting tread for confidence in all conditions.' 60 TPI; Hard-Case Lite; semi-slick; folding clincher. 700C x 25 mm 260 g, 90-125 psi; 28 mm 300 g, 60-115 psi; 32 mm 335 g, 45-90 psi; 38 mm 450 g, 35-80 psi. The black option showed as unavailable, with no replacement offered; no price shown for this tire.
